title: Abeno Harukas
visualBrief: Abeno Harukas compact exterior preserves the western Tower-Kan perimeter, three stepped glass stages, the full mapped station/mall podium and an open sky court inside the observation gallery. Detailed original master independently preserved.

geographicProposal.notes: Two inspected exterior pictures show the western offset tower, three stepped glass stages, broad station podium and rooftop gallery. Preserve the original 300m height, mapped 274.821×87.837m podium and separate Tower-Kan perimeter. PMTiles confirms the station/mall location and surrounding roads; native +X follows the long station axis and the tower stays around nativeX−89m. Upper stages and sky court retain the original exterior reconstruction. Off-podium PMTiles point[0,80]25.2447m sets approximate ground contact; center37.7806m has coarse urban roof imprint. Bounded rectangular preview contacts cover the entire podium and retain raw samples separately. Exact fins, planting, service equipment, station thresholds and gallery court dimensions remain approximate.
